openspec.rationale: Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; version matches package.json. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.

speckit.rationale: Exact pin per the repo dependency-pin discipline; adapter verified against v1.x specs/ layout. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.
speckit.notes: install: uv tool install specify-cli; artifacts under .specify/ and specs/<slug>/{spec.md,plan.md,tasks.md}

native-kbd.rationale: Pack-owned backend; version tracks this repo, no external pin. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.

customEngines.hint: To plug in another spec engine, implement the five adapter ops (list/progress/mark_done/verify/archive) as <prefix>_* functions in kbd-apply.sh, add its detection shape to backend_detect and the pin value to the specBackend case, then register its metadata here. See docs/guide/spec-engines.md.
